newsitem.title: UK: Racal to sell unit to Litton Industries.
newsitem.headline: Racal to sell unit to Litton Industries.

text.p: Britain's Racal Electronics Plc said on Thursday it agreed to sell its Racal-Decca marine electronics business to U.S. firm Litton Industries Inc for 29.5 million stg cash.

Racal said it expected to have an exceptional gain of about 6.0 million stg on the sale of the unit, which is based at New Malden, Surrey, in southeast England. The transaction includes all of the global businesses of Racal-Decca Marine group, with the exception of UK Decca navigator chains and the non-marine activities of Decca South Africa, Racal said in a statement.
Racal said it planned to use proceeds from the sale, due to close by the end of its financial year, to reduce debt.

Racal-Decca, which focuses on the field of maritime radar and navigation systems, had an operating profit of about 3.1 million stg for the year ended March 31, before reorganisation charges of 0.8 million stg.
"The sale of this business forms an important part of Racal's stated strategy of focusing on its core activities," the company said.
